import sys

def main():
    # Read first line: dimensions N and M
    line1 = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not line1:
        print("Safe")
        return
    
    parts = line1.split()
    n = int(parts[0])
    m = int(parts[1])
    
    # Read second line: size followed by the string of movement values
    line2 = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not line2:
        print("Safe")
        return
    
    parts2 = line2.split()
    if not parts2:
        print("Safe")
        return
    
    movement_string = ''.join(parts2[1:]) if len(parts2) > 1 else ""
    
    # Read third line: initial location of JARVIS
    line3 = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not line3:
        print("Safe")
        return
    
    parts3 = line3.split()
    i = int(parts3[0])
    j = int(parts3[1])
    
    # Check if starting position is already out of bounds
    if i < 0 or i >= n or j < 0 or j >= m:
        print("Unsafe")
        return
    
    # Process movements
    for move in movement_string:
        if move == 'F':
            # Front: decrease row index
            i -= 1
        elif move == 'B':
            # Back: increase row index
            i += 1
        elif move == 'L':
            # Left: decrease column index
            j -= 1
        elif move == 'R':
            # Right: increase column index
            j += 1
        
        # Check if out of bounds after each move
        if i < 0 or i >= n or j < 0 or j >= m:
            print("Unsafe")
            return
    
    print("Safe")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
